title: Certain Persons Not to Have Weapons
grade_or_penalty: Firearm: 2nd degree with mandatory parole ineligibility. Other weapons: 4th degree (3rd degree in some cases)
key_points: Prohibits persons convicted of specified crimes, and certain others (such as persons under DV restraining orders), from possessing weapons or firearms.
elements: The suspect possessed a firearm (or other weapon)
The suspect knew he possessed it
The suspect falls in a prohibited class (for example, a prior conviction for a listed offense)
